title: Various Locations – Proposed Agreement with the Los Angeles County
text:
Various Locations – Proposed Agreement with the Los Angeles County
  Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk for the use of Department of Recreation and
  Parks Facilities to Host Voting Centers in Connection with the November 2026
  General Election – Categorical Exemption from the Provisions of the California
  Environment Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to Article 19, Section 15301
  [Operation, Repair, Maintenance, Permitting, Leasing, Licensing, or Minor
  Alteration of Existing Public or Private Structures, Facilities, Mechanical
  Equipment, or Topographical Features, Involving Negligible or No Expansion of
  Existing or Former Use] of California CEQA Guidelines and Article III, Section 1,
  Class 1(14) of City CEQA Guidelines
